Subject: Interest in pilot + mutual plan template

Hi Hannah —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Crestline is interested in running a short pilot focused on discharge summary generation for two outpatient clinics. Before we lock dates, could you share the mutual action plan / evaluation template you typically use? We want something we can circulate to stakeholders (clinical, security, procurement).

High-level asks:
- A 4–6 week evaluation cadence (we prefer a short POC)
- Acceptance criteria examples (quality thresholds and safety checks)
- Roles we should include from our side for approvals

If you have a quick starter doc + slide outline, that would help us prepare for an internal review next week.

Regards,

Sarah —

Great to hear — excited to run this with Crestline. I attached a starter MAP doc and a 1-slide timeline deck (small stubs you can drop into your internal review). Quick summary below and then the links/attachments.

Proposed starter (we can compress or expand):
- Week 0: Kickoff + access & data scope signoff
- Week 1–2: Integration + baseline eval (sample generation & qualitative review)
- Week 3–4: Iteration + safety checks + latency/cost tuning
- Week 5: Acceptance testing with clinical raters
- Week 6: Close & recommendation (move-to-prod proposal)

Suggested acceptance criteria (examples):
- Precision/recall or BLEU-like metric thresholds on targeted sections (we can propose exact metrics once we see a sample set)
- Safety: no PHI leakage above agreed threshold; privacy checks on transformed outputs
- Ops: 95th-percentile response time < 450ms for the evaluation batch profile

Docs & links (editable):
- MAP starter doc: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2bCrestlineMAPDoc (Crestline_MAP_Template_v1.docx attached)
- 1-slide timeline: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1D4E-CrestlineTimeline (Crestline_Eval_Timeline_v1.gslides attached)

Please confirm: 1) who from your team will be the clinical reviewer(s) + procurement contact, and 2) if Aug 11 for a 30–45min kickoff works. If you prefer a compressed 4-week sprint we can tighten the iteration window.

Thanks — I’ll loop in Marissa to propose acceptance-test facilitation and Ben for infra requirements.

—
Hannah Schmitt

Quick notes after skimming the starter doc:
- Acceptance criteria: add an explicit clinical-signoff gate (two independent raters for sample set of n=200)
- Risk checks: include an automated PHI redaction spot-check on a random 5% of outputs weekly
- Deployment: for the pilot we recommend using a Dedicated instance (small GPU pool) so we can instrument latency and cost per inference accurately

Workshop proposal (to align raters & success metrics):
- 60-min alignment workshop on Aug 13, 10:00–11:00 PT (we can run remotely)
- Agenda: intake of crestline sample docs, define raters & rubric, quick run of baseline samples

Ben — can you confirm infra pre-reqs if we start Aug 11 vs Aug 18?

Sarah — can you share the clinical reviewers and approximate sample size (we suggested 200)? If procurement needs a separate thread for terms we can copy them in.
